summary: Etoiles Capital Group filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its October 15, 2026 Annual General Meeting, the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer. On the September 17 record date, 15,110,000 Class A shares were outstanding with no Class B shares; roughly 90.09% of Class A votes were represented. Shareholders approved five items, including relocation of incorporation from the Cayman Islands to Nevada via domestication, new charter documents, election of four directors, auditor ratification, and adjournment authority. The company expects domestication to complete on or around October 19, 2026. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; watch redomiciliation mechanics and any disclosure or tax effects.
